excerpt_i18n.es: El Ministerio de Industria, Comercio y Energía de Corea del Sur anunció el miércoles que el país lanzará el próximo mes un proyecto valorado en 1 billón de wones surcoreanos (aproximadamente 687,8 millones de euros) para desarrollar semiconductores de inteligencia artificial (IA) para dispositivos. Según el ministerio, el gobierno y las empresas privadas invertirán en total 1 billón de wones surcoreanos en este proyecto durante los próximos cinco años, con el objetivo de crear alrededor de 10 tipos de chips de IA que se pueden utilizar en vehículos autónomos, electrodomésticos inteligentes y robots humanoides.

items.title: I taught GPT-OSS-120B to see using Google Lens and OpenCV

Also includes Google Search, News, Shopping, Scholar, Maps, Finance, Weather, Flights, Hotels, Translate, Images, Trends, and more. 17 tools total. items.raw_excerpt: 米兰·科尔蒂纳冬奥会2月6日正式开幕。在意大利米兰斯福尔扎古堡前广场，国际奥委会主席柯丝蒂·考文垂参观了充满未来感的“米兰·阿里廊”（Alibaba Wonder on Ice），沉浸式体验了AI数字购物。     （图：国际奥委会主席考文垂在“米兰·阿里廊”沉浸式体验AI数字购物）     淘宝Vision打造了一个未来购物空间，为冬奥会带来 “AI+3D+XR”相融合的先锋体验。游客戴上头显后，就能在AI助手帮助下，创建基于千问大模型生成的专属数字人形象，选择服饰、妆容、喷上香水，参加一场奇妙的冰雪舞会。   这场全观感奇幻之旅，基于阿里巴巴的云和AI技术底座。淘宝Vision自研的3D高斯真人数字人技术，通过实时渲染与空间交互，实现从挑选货物到虚拟试用的AI数字购物链路，让更多人以数字化、个性化的方式参与冬奥会，拥有属于自己的奥运时刻。   "米兰·阿里廊"是阿里巴巴在米兰斯福尔扎古堡前广场设置的体验馆，于米兰冬奥会和残奥会期间对游客开放。展馆由一颗直径8.8米的透明水晶球和一座总长约30米的冰晶穹顶组成。水晶球白天作为互动空间，夜间变身为AI生成视觉内容的投影表面。   “Ciao～我是来自Alibaba的AI小助手！欢迎你来到Wonder on Ice的梦幻舞会。”游客进入"米兰·阿里廊"后，AI助手就会打招呼，引导签到、拍照、生成专属入场券，随后就进入了虚拟试衣体验区。   在这里，AI助手会识别体验者的穿衣风格，通过简单问答和手势交互，推荐舞会穿搭。“你看看这两款怎么样？左边这款采用仿生学设计，环保材质，可以凸显你的身材，右边这款具有防水保温的功效。”     （图：游客可以生成专属数字人，体验虚拟换装） &nb

excerpt_i18n.en:
The Milan Cortina Winter Olympics officially opened on February 6. At the Piazza in front of Sforza Castle in Milan, Italy, IOC President Kirsty Coventry visited the futuristic "Milan Alibaba Wonder on Ice" and experienced immersive AI digital shopping.

Taobao Vision created a future shopping space, bringing an advanced experience of "AI + 3D + XR" to the Winter Olympics. After donning headsets, visitors can create personalized digital avatars with the help of AI assistants, choose clothing, makeup, and perfume, and attend a magical ice ball.

This full-sensory fantastical journey is built on Alibaba's cloud and AI technology foundation. Taobao Vision's self-developed 3D Gaussian real-person digital human technology, through real-time rendering and spatial interaction, realizes an AI digital shopping chain from selecting goods to virtual try-ons, allowing more people to participate in the Winter Olympics in a digital and personalized way, creating their own Olympic moments.

The "Milan Alibaba Wonder on Ice" is an exhibition hall set up by Alibaba in the Piazza in front of Sforza Castle, open to visitors during the Milan Winter Olympics and Paralympics. The exhibit features a transparent crystal sphere with a diameter of 8.8 meters and a total length of about 30 meters.

excerpt_i18n.en: A court filing in a trademark lawsuit reveals OpenAI won't use the name “io” for its AI hardware device, which isn't expected to ship until 2027.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 一份商标诉讼的法院文件显示，OpenAI 不会使用 “io” 这个名称为其 AI 硬件设备命名，该设备预计要到 2027 年才会发货。
excerpt_i18n.es: Un documento presentado en un pleito por derechos de marca revela que OpenAI no utilizará el nombre "io" para su dispositivo de hardware de IA, que no se espera que se envíe hasta 2027.

items.title: 豆包官宣总台春晚互动玩法 将送机器人等十万份科技大礼
items.raw_excerpt: 2月10日，豆包宣布“豆包过年”新春活动正式开启，活动期间将为用户发放新春红包。此外，除夕夜的中央广播电视总台2026年春晚期间，豆包还将为全国观众送出超过10万份接入豆包大模型的科技好礼，以及现金红包。  据介绍，今年的豆包新春活动分为两个阶段。第一阶段将于2月13日20点正式启动，用户可进入豆包App新春活动页面，体验AI生成拜年祝福等AI过年玩法，即可参与抽奖赢取红包，中奖后可提现。  2月16日除夕夜，豆包将在中央广播电视总台春晚期间，配合直播互动，开启第二阶段红包及科技礼包抽奖。当晚，用户将有三轮机会赢取最高8888元的现金红包或接入豆包大模型的智能科技好礼。  据了解，此次豆包送出的“科技礼包”囊括17款热门产品，包括宇树机器人、拓竹3D打印机、大疆无人机等前沿科技产品，也有极米投影仪、苏泊尔电饭煲等智能消费品，同时，科技好礼中还涵盖上汽奥迪E5 Sportback和奔驰CLA两款电车使用权。  值得一提的是，此次抽取的科技奖品均通过火山引擎深度融合了豆包大模型能力。以总台春晚即将送出的宇树机器人为例，其拟人的音色与语气由豆包大模型的语音合成模型、大语言模型（LLM）以及视觉语言模型（VLM）技术提供支持。奖品中的上汽奥迪E5  Sportback基于豆包大模型打造“奥迪助手”，让用户和汽车可以实现近乎真人的自然对话体验。  “豆包过年”项目负责人表示，希望借助科技礼包，让更多人感受到大模型发展为生活带来的便利，也希望借此激发更多人关注并参与科技创新，让科技成果更多走进生活。  从目前公布的红包规则来看，今年豆包新春活动有两个亮点：一是简单直接，互动玩法门槛低，用户可直接领取红包；二是形式新颖，除基础红包外，科技礼包品类丰富，覆盖了从前沿科技到日常家居的多元场景，将线上互动进一步延展

excerpt_i18n.en:
On February 10, Doudou announced the official launch of its "Doudou New Year" Spring Festival event, during which it will distribute New Year red envelopes to users. Additionally, during the CCTV 2026 Spring Festival Gala on New Year's Eve, Doudou will offer over 100,000 tech gifts integrated with the Doudou large model and cash red envelopes to viewers nationwide.

The Doudou New Year event this year is divided into two phases. The first phase begins at 8 PM on February 13, when users can enter the Doudou App's Spring Festival event page to experience AI-generated New Year greetings and other AI-themed activities, participating in draws to win red envelopes, which can be cashed out upon winning.

On New Year's Eve, February 16, Doudou will initiate the second phase of red envelope and tech gift draws during the CCTV Spring Festival Gala, synchronized with live interactive segments. That night, users will have three chances to win cash red envelopes up to 8,888 yuan or smart tech gifts connected to the Doudou large model.

It is understood that the "tech gift packages" offered by Doudou include 17 popular products, such as the Unitree robot, Topology 3D printer, DJI drone, and consumer electronics like the JIMI projector and Supor rice cooker. Additionally, the tech gifts feature the use rights for two electric vehicles: the SAIC Audi E5 Sportback and the Mercedes-Benz CLA.

Notably, all the tech prizes drawn this time are deeply integrated with the capabilities of the Doudou large model. For instance, the Unitree robot to be given away during the CCTV Spring Festival Gala features human-like voice and tone generated by the Doudou large model.
